name: signpost
intendedUse: Wayfinding on Works-authored surfaces: the Wolfsblvt Works site's personal navigation and other places that point a visitor along a walk of sections.
modifications: Option C ("Sketched") from the Works website finishing sheet, with the two upper boards narrowed and offset so each reads on its own.

redistribution.notes: Original geometry is distributed from this repository with the package source.

authoringNotes: Three boards (right, left, small right) on one post. Edges run slightly past their corners like a quick pencil sketch; the hand-drawn feel lives in the geometry, with no filters or transforms. Not a replacement for lucide:signpost in ordinary directional UI.
